richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the possibility exists that some of the screws which secure the rooflight may not have been tightened correctly. This in the worst case scenario may result in the roof light becoming detached.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the rooflight securing screws checked and the correct torque applied. Where necessary the rooflight will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: ROOF LIGHT IN OVERHEAD CAB MAY BECOME DETACHED
